traps.the_label_is_the_hazard: Every field a house-card parser wants — name, 'Grade', 'School', 'Teacher' — is identifying information about a minor. The venue prior (§4.1b) says 'the Met'; the gallery says 'education centre, temporary show'; the label grammar says 'not a tombstone'. Any one of those should stop the extractor before it stores a name. The rule is in the protocol now so the frame is never taken; this fixture is what a compliant record of such a work looks like.
